findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-saas_studio" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_live_preview · Private data: delete_capture_job, studio_verify · Public sink: studio_upload_recon, studio_publish · Destructive: reset_checklist, delete_capture_job, studio_build.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_live_preview · Private data: delete_capture_job, studio_verify · Public sink: studio_upload_recon, studio_publish · Destructive: reset_checklist, delete_capture_job, studio_build

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
